sentences.text: BETWEEN:-
VIJAY @ VISHAL S/O SHRI GANPAT CHOUHAN, AGED
ABOUT 42 YEARS

, OCCUPATION: LABOUR R/O VILLAGE  PARBHANI DISTT. MAHARASHTA (MAHARASHTRA)
 
 (BY SHRI BASANT RAJ PANDEY - ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION NIMBOLA DISTRICT BURHANPUR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI D. K. PAROHA - GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

This is an application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 16.12.2022 in connection with Crime No. 644/2022, registered at Police Station Nimbola District Burhanpur for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(K), 376(2)(n), 506 of the IPC and Section 5L/6 of the POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 16.12.2022.
Prosecutrix has already been examined in the Court.
Prosecutrix is aged about 16 1/2 years.
There are 19 witnesses in the case and trial is likely to take some time.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: 1 4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Perused the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C and considering the period of custody, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
7.

In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE DUBEY/-
